subject.title: fix(feishu): retry once on token-invalid errors 99991663/99991664 with cache invalidation (fixes #97287)

question: Should Feishu invalid-token recovery invalidate only the affected account, or may this PR intentionally clear every Feishu account’s in-memory SDK and CardKit caches before becoming the canonical fix for https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/97287?
rationale: Both policies can recover the reported failure, but the PR’s process-wide invalidation affects unrelated accounts and another open PR competes for the same ownership boundary; repository evidence cannot establish the intended operational policy without the Feishu owner.

options.title: Scope this PR per account
options.body: Pass the affected account identity through the retry callback, invalidate only its SDK and CardKit entries, refresh the branch, and land this proof-positive implementation as the canonical fix.

options.title: Accept global invalidation
options.body: Document that any invalid-token response intentionally refreshes every in-process Feishu account and land this PR after exact-head checks pass.

options.title: Choose the competing PR
options.body: Pause this branch and adopt https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/97431 only after it covers ordinary sends and supplies positive real-behavior proof.

recommendation.title: Scope this PR per account
recommendation.body: Pass the affected account identity through the retry callback, invalidate only its SDK and CardKit entries, refresh the branch, and land this proof-positive implementation as the canonical fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The package explicitly identifies @m1heng as the Feishu community owner, so they are best placed to choose the cache-isolation and canonical-branch policy.
